claimed_coverage: Tests verify that DALI executor and pipeline APIs accept std::string_view arguments for query methods (InputFeedCount, GetOperator, NodePtr, NodeId, TensorId, TensorPtr, GetReaderMeta, GetInputLayout, GetInputNdim, GetInputDtype) as modified in fix.patch, eliminating unnecessary string allocations and enabling efficient heterogeneous map lookups.
fix_patch_grounding: The tests directly verify all concrete API changes from fix.patch: (1) InputFeedCount signature changed from const std::string& to std::string_view in ExecutorBase and all implementations, (2) GetOperator(std::string_view) method added returning OperatorBase*, (3) NodePtr(std::string_view) and NodeId(std::string_view) methods added to OpGraph for O(1) lookup, (4) TensorId returns std::optional<TensorNodeId> instead of throwing, (5) TensorPtr(std::string_view) added, (6) AddOp returns OpNode& instead of void, (7) input_operators_ and tensor_name_to_id_ maps use std::less<> for heterogeneous lookup, (8) Pipeline methods (GetOperatorNode, GetInputOperatorNode, GetReaderMeta, GetInputLayout, GetInputNdim, GetInputDtype) all use std::string_view.
issue_context_used: The issue describes modernizing public query interfaces to accept std::string_view for efficiency when called from C API, avoiding temporary string allocations, and adding GetOperator() for direct operator access; the tests verify these behavioral changes are correctly applied to all affected source files.
notes: Created comprehensive Python-based tests that verify the string_view API modernization. test_fix_verification.py directly inspects source files to verify all fix.patch changes are applied (fails on buggy code, passes on fixed code). test_string_view_api.py tests Python bindings behavior when DALI is built. A C++ test file (test_string_view_api.cc) is also provided for when DALI is fully built with GTest. The verifier correctly returns non-zero exit code for buggy /workspace and zero exit code for fixed /workspace_fixed.
